en: The types of POKéMON match up\ndifferently with each other.\pEvery type is stronger than some\ntypes and weaker than others.
A NUGGET is totally useless.\nSo I sold it for ¥5000.
I heard that ghosts haunt\nLAVENDER TOWN.

Oh… {PLAYER}!
I've been looking for you!\pIt's me, one of the ever-present
AIDES to PROF. OAK.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on twenty species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward from PROF. OAK.\pHe entrusted me with this
EVERSTONE.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
twenty kinds of POKéMON?
Great! You have caught or owned\n{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pCongratulations!\nHere you go!

Making POKéMON evolve certainly
can add to the POKéDEX.\pHowever, at times, you may not
want a certain POKéMON to evolve.\pIn that case, give the EVERSTONE
to that POKéMON.\pIt will prevent evolution according
to the PROFESSOR.
